text_block_list.text: (Waaaah...!)

"The Swan Stakes was a sprint GII race.
Yet on this day, the excitement was on par with a GI. The reason, of course, being—"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Huh... this is my first time watching in person...
I had no idea the sprint division got this hype."

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
So, where are the rumored ones—
Sakura Bakushin O and North Flight?

text_block_list.name: Bakushin Fans
text_block_list.text:
Go, Bakushin O--!!
1,400m is basically 1,200m! That's your distance!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes, exaaactly!
Everyone, cheer even louder, please!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ready, and!?

text_block_list.name: Bakushin Fans
text_block_list.text: "BAKUSHIIIIIN!"

text_block_list.name: Flight Fans
text_block_list.text:
Flight-san's speed won't lose out either!
1400m is basically 1600m anyway! You can do it~!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, everyone!
Please watch me shine!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Umm... how am I
supposed to rile them up?

text_block_list.name: Flight Fans
text_block_list.text:
......Flight!
Fiiiiight~~~~!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the rhyming sounds so lovely♪
Thank you very much!
I'll do my best—fight-o♪

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Whoaaaaa...!

She is Biko Pegasus. An Umamusume one generation below
North Flight, seemingly gearing up to give her all
in the sprint division from here on.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
The upperclassmen's fans are bursting with energy!
Well, of course they are—I mean――

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
It's a clash of heroes, after all!
The absolute hero of speed, Bakushin O-senpai, and—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
The up-and-coming hero with supple strength,
Flight-senpai! Truly a dream showdown!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
All right!
I'm gonna give it my all too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Flight-san!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: "I let you have the Yasuda Kinen, but... I'm not losing today!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
If you have your pride at 1600m,
then I have mine... at 1200m!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"To be precise, at ALL distances!
This exemplary speed is all it takes! I shall conquer them all!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"So naturally!
1400m is—my territory!"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...That confidence of yours
is really, really cool.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: "That is precisely why I am glad. If I defeat you today—"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
My coordination options have expanded.
1400m suits me best, too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Flight-san...!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: "You must not chase after me at the Yasuda Kinen."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: I've gotten so, so much faster than I was back then!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of everyone who supports me!
With the brilliance of my radiance――I shall seize victory!
